addition-five-digits.description: Back in float64, with token embeddings replaced by digit * one scalar and the head by a scalar turn and phase, leaving the 12-row position table as the only table.

boolean-circuit-5-bits.description: Scalar-state CA without W_k: keys are raw positions and W_q is a scaled rotation, sharpness beta=200.

date-normalization.description: First dot of yyyy.mm.dd found by position (flag O overlaid on i=4) instead of a digit 3 back, dropping the Z3 dim. 25 stream dims used.

decimal-to-binary-8bit.description: Degrees-of-freedom probe: W_v and W_o replaced by hard-wired read of VAL and two output scales, head reads only MODE. Bespoke rather than a standard transformer.

digit-counting-10.description: Attention is a bilinear metric per layer, score = x diag(m) x', with the value fixed to the flag channel: 6 attention numbers in total, in score units. d_model=3.

edit-distance-8.description: Each head returns one scalar value, shrinking W_v and W_o from 7x6 to 7x2; shared cell, d=7, ff=3.

gcd-three-digits.description: Final model: SharedQueryRadix4N12 with positions as a fixed one-hot buffer. Euclid by radix-4 folds, 12 tied rounds, 0/10^6 wrong end to end in float32.

linear-interpolation-two-points.description: NullSlope19 with dig removed: digit tokens are -10d in out, READ takes value -0.1 out, and the floor shift moves into the head via phase; d_model 9.

multiplication-five-digits.description: LinearSink_v10 with one shared ramp K over multiplicand, sink and output digits (7 registers). The multiplicand is shifted down by e^-100, undone by the digit query in block 1 and invisible to block 2.

nli-snli.description: Every lexicon vote scaled by 2.0, following the gain at 1.5.

paraphrase-mrpc.description: 2-bit char codes: letters share 4 classes, so 8-char windows match by hash; answer 1 iff any window in the first 40 chars of sent2 matches.

parity-upto10-bits.description: tied_tent_map with attention's four matrices removed: a fixed uniform causal average needs no parameters, so all remaining weights are embeddings, tent map or head.

sentiment-sst2.description: big_w10_negw15 with a 12-character shift register, to see where the register length curve flattens. d_model 117.

smallest-prime-factor.description: Replaces the 10 position one-hots with a place-value score, s, s^2 and 3 step flags; the copy head becomes Gaussian attention -BETA(i-(s-5))^2 in a 2-dim head.

sort-five-digits.description: e14 with both position tables trimmed to the 10 used rows: the smallest model found, d_model=1 in float64.

trec-coarse.description: Restores the e20 keywords; drops '^what is the'=ENTY so those questions default to DESC.

word-reversal-3x3.description: E27 with softmax replaced by argmax, so no leakage and no beta. Only the 3 query coefficients remain, at the cost of a non-standard attention rule.
